title: Lead Data Center Technician
description:

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. You will be responsible for our two most important data center operations metrics: mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to repair (MTTR). You are great at following directions, are a fast learner and are super attentive to details. You are accessible via cell phone and willing to get onsite when there are emergencies as needed. • Labeling and troubleshooting for fiber/optics cables

• Power supply cabling, installation, troubleshooting and repair

• Installation of racks, servers and switches; this includes staging racks in place, cabling, power up and handoff of hardware to the provisioning team for customer capacity allocation.

• Manage, response and resolution of data center operations tickets used cross functionally within SpaceXSI via Jira.

• Create and Maintain documentation of tasks and standard operating procedures

• Manage spare parts inventory within the data center

• Define, design, and implement network layouts and solutions within our data centers

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 5+ years of experience working with server, storage, compute and network hardware

• 5+ Years of experience troubleshooting and repairing servers and networking infrastructure

• 5+ years of experience in Inventory Management, and ordering, receiving and shipping server and network equipment

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Position is subject to pre-employment and annual post employment background checks

• Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to noise

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

Support the Chief of Staff to the Chief External Affairs & Growth Officer through policy and business research, executive briefing preparation, project coordination, and tracking of organizational priorities. The intern will synthesize complex information into clear, actionable materials and support internal and external engagements involving energy, regulatory, legislative, political, and market issues. Constellation's 2027 Summer Intern Program will run approximately 10 weeks, from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to see how strategy, public policy, legal, communications, sustainability, advocacy, and development come together. The intern will work directly with the Chief of Staff and support projects that cut across the External Affairs & Growth organization, gaining exposure to senior leaders, enterprise priorities, and the processes behind executive decision-making.

External Affairs & Growth brings together teams responsible for Legal; Public Policy; Sustainability & Policy Analysis; Strategy, Corporate Affairs & Public Advocacy; and Development.
